_comment_strategy: CPR Gold Bot v2.0 — M15 CPR breakout, H1+H4 EMA50 dual trend filter, ATR SL clamped $15-$17, RR 2.0 TP, fixed-dollar sizing ($100 for score >=5, $66 for score 4), daily auto-tuner. Risk does NOT scale with balance. All settings defaults centralized in config_loader.DEFAULTS.
_comment_position: Flat position sizing: score 5–6 → $100 full, score 4 → $66 partial. Units = position_usd / sl_usd.
_comment_sl_tp: SL = ATR(14) × 1.0, clamped to [$15, $17]. TP = SL × rr_ratio. RR gate: actual RR must meet rr_ratio before execution.
_comment_be: Breakeven disabled — RR 2.0 and tight SL ceiling provide sufficient structural protection.
_comment_trend: Dual trend filter: H1 EMA50 + H4 EMA50. 0.15% buffer zone around H4 EMA prevents blocking on minor oscillations.
_comment_sessions: Three sessions active. Asian threshold raised to 5 (stricter — CPR breakouts less reliable during Asian ranging).
_comment_news_fail_closed: fail-closed: if calendar_cache.json is missing/unreadable, BLOCK new entries until the first successful fetch (matches Rogue-H1). Set false to pass trades when the calendar is unavailable.
_comment_caps: Win cap: 1 win/session then sit out the rest. Loss cap: 3 losses/day, 2/session. These are the most important capital preservation rules.
_comment_cooldowns: min_reentry_wait_min is the global post-SL cooldown (any setup); same_setup_cooldown_min is the same-setup-name re-entry cooldown. They are independent keys.
_comment_infra: 5-min cycle, 90-day rolling history, daily auto-tuner at 08:00 SGT.
